assumptions.z_p_convention: Z_p grows downward from the top-case top face; the board top is 12.50 and the cavity floor is 18.20.
assumptions.case_mesh_frame: 3MF print frame; offset recovered from bottomcase-draft/bottom-*-world.stl; 3MF ray-cast directly.

method.relocated_block: B.CrtYd bounding box -> board -> plate -> world; 9x9 grid; first ray hit from Z 14.10 downward; min surface over the grid; free = surface - (14.10 + 0.80); clearance = free - nominal part height.
method.usb_c: J1 B.Fab body box; stock 12.8 mm notch at plate X 19.35 and printed 14.75 mm notch at the PH60 centre; 12.35 mm max overmold; body box vs bottom-case mesh boolean intersection; vertical notch closed end from spec.
method.stabilizer_7u: 7U NPTH pads from the board; plate cutout from the INKC DXF (ezdxf flattening); circle-to-polygon-boundary distance minus radius.

j3_plug_corridor.note: 3.5 mm wide insertion corridor; the JST SH plug body height is not in CAD, so only the corridor free height is checked.

vertical.note: The J1 body is below the board; the notch closed end is above the board top. The plug overmold height above the board is not in CAD.

missing_inputs: USB-C plug overmold height above the board (the 12.8 mm notch depth is 8.7 mm from the lip; the J1 body is below the board)
actual plug overmold width and corner radius (12.35 mm is the spec maximum, not a measured plug)

stabilizer_7u.compatibility_note: The 7U footprint is a PCB-mount NPTH pattern; the INKC plate cutout is a plate-mount stabilizer cutout.  If the build uses the PCB-mount stabilizer, the plate cutout must clear the stabilizer housing/legs; the insert holes are outside the cutout as drawn.  If the build uses a plate-mount stabilizer, the PCB NPTH holes are unused and this geometric mismatch is not a build failure.
missing_inputs: actual 7U stabilizer type (PCB-mount vs plate-mount) and housing dimensions
plate 3MF (only the DXF is available; the DXF cutout is used)
Actual J3, U13, U11, U12 and 0603 body heights (the values used are datasheet/package nominals, not caliper readings).
USB-C plug overmold height above the board and its actual width/corner radius (12.35 mm is the spec maximum).
7U stabilizer type (PCB-mount vs plate-mount) and housing dimensions; the plate 3MF is not available, only the DXF (the PCB-mount variant is a DXF/Gerber, not a 3MF).
Printed case floor Z and flatness (the CAD floor is 18.20; print tolerance and gasket compression are not modelled).
Solder/paste thickness and component placement tolerance (the clearance numbers are nominal CAD, not worst-case assembly).
physical_measurements: Caliper the JST SH SM10B-SRSS-TB body height above the PCB and the mating plug overmold height/width.
Caliper the 0603, SOT-23, TSSOP-20 and RVZ14 parts after reflow (or measure the assembled board).
Measure the printed bottom-case cavity floor Z under the relocated block and the USB passage.
Measure the 7U stabilizer housing and confirm whether the build uses PCB-mount or plate-mount stabilizers.
Measure the actual gasket compression at full travel and the resulting board Z.
Measure the USB-C plug overmold and test insertion in the 12.8 mm stock notch, the 14.75 mm printed notch, and the J1-centred 14.75 mm variant.
Test-fit the PCB-mount plate variant (models/rule60-v3-hhkb-gas-plate-pcb-mount.dxf) and the J3 relief bottom case (models/maru60-hhkb-bottomcase-j3-relief-left.3mf).
